instructions.zh: 给脸上背光的部分补一点亮度，已经亮的地方保持。
instructions.en: Open up the dim side of the face a bit and leave the lit side alone.

instructions.zh: 把画面里的暗处提起来一截，天上亮云原样保留。
instructions.en: Bring up the darker tones so more is visible, leaving the bright clouds as they are.

instructions.zh: 把树下的阴影压得更深，天和水面不用变。
instructions.en: Deepen the shade below the trees and leave the sky and water as they are.

instructions.zh: 拉低暗部的亮度，让人像的阴影更有深度，白衫别变。
instructions.en: Pull the shadow tones down for a deeper portrait, leaving the white shirt alone.

instructions.zh: 这张整体太暗了，整幅图的曝光提一档。
instructions.en: The whole frame is too dim. Bring the exposure up a notch across the image.

instructions.zh: 全画面再亮一点，包括前景、人物和天空，保留层次。
instructions.en: Give the entire photo a little more light, including the foreground, people and sky, while keeping tonal detail.

instructions.zh: 整张稍微压暗一些，别只改阴影。
instructions.en: Make the whole photograph a little darker, including its lighter areas.

instructions.zh: 整体曝光太高，整幅画面往回收一档。
instructions.en: The shot is too bright overall. Bring the exposure down across the frame.

instructions.zh: 降低整体对比度，尽量保持平均亮度。
instructions.en: Reduce overall contrast while keeping the average brightness about the same.

instructions.zh: 提亮脸上的暗部，再把天空的高光压下来。
instructions.en: Lift the shadowed parts of the face and also pull down the bright sky highlights.

instructions.zh: 看看要不要调整曝光，保留现在的气氛。
instructions.en: See if the exposure needs a change, while preserving the current mood.

instructions.zh: 暗部和亮部都原样保留，什么也别改。
instructions.en: Leave the shadows and highlights exactly as they are and make no changes.

instructions.zh: 请原样保留，不要编辑。
instructions.en: Keep the picture unchanged.

instructions.zh: 请把背景里的路人移除。
instructions.en: Remove the person in the background.

instructions.zh: 加一点棕褐色的复古色调。
instructions.en: Add a subtle brown sepia tone.

instructions.zh: 把整张照片的曝光明显提高。
instructions.en: Raise the exposure of the whole photograph noticeably.

instructions.zh: 显著压暗阴影，保持高光。
instructions.en: Darken the shadows noticeably, preserving highlights.

instructions.zh: 把暗部提亮，亮部原样保留。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows and keep the highlights unchanged.

instructions.zh: 暗部只提一点点，但同一处暗部也要大幅提亮。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows a little, but also lift the same shadows substantially.

instructions.zh: 明显提亮阴影，不要提亮高光。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows noticeably, but do not brighten the highlights.

prompts.joint: Classify the edit actually requested, not details the user wants preserved. A lift shadows only. B deepen shadows only. C brighten the entire photograph. D darken the entire photograph. E another task, no change, unclear direction, or multiple different changes. Return only A, B, C, D, or E.
prompts.scope: Which tonal region is the user asking to change? A shadows or dark tones specifically. B overall brightness or exposure of the whole photo. C neither, mixed regions, or unclear scope. Ignore parts the user wants to preserve. Return only A, B, or C.
prompts.direction: What brightness direction is explicitly requested? A lighter. B darker. C no specified direction, another operation, no edit, or both directions. Ignore what should be preserved. Return only A, B, or C.

method: Frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B CPU float32, text only. Compare one joint five-way choice to two independent three-way scope/direction choices. Map a split pair into one of four tone routes only if both axes are A or B, otherwise defer. No image, no action magnitudes, no visual quality evidence or deployment.
